rooms.purpose: Trail-shelter supplies and a ski volunteer quietly passing on the kindness of strangers.

lines: I help stock the ski-trail shelters.
Someone always leaves a neat little pile of split kindling.
Nobody signs it. We just pass it on.

rooms.purpose: Free final-trail recovery and a native PC, with a winter traveler's spare-mitten lesson.

lines: Keep spare mittens in a bread bag. That's what my cousin told me.
I laughed until mine fell through the ice.

rooms.purpose: Registration for the four-member Minnesota League run; public clinic and supplies remain available without registering.
FERN teaches that small changes and cooperation make a team stronger.
FLINT connects endurance to the strains recorded in Minnesota stone.
VEIL asks a challenger to notice what is hard to see instead of rushing.
REED tests how a challenger guides power before the final room.
CASEY honors the partners that carried the player across Minnesota before the final registered match.
Record partners by name after a real League victory; a fish-house family photograph gives the record a personal meaning.

lines: My dad's team photo hangs in our fish house.
I thought his grin meant he never lost.
Now I know he just kept trying.
Let's get your team's good side.

rooms.purpose: Free windbreak care and PC access, a lighthouse grandfather mending mittens and a deckhand learning the value of coming home.
